timeline.reflow: f1 = eOut(seg(ph, 1.45, 1.62)), f2 = sstep(2.56, 2.76, ph), kr = eIO(seg(ph, 9.7, 10.05)), ka = eOut(seg(ph, 10.02, 10.4)); kept card: k1 = eIO(seg(ph, 1.6 + .025 i1, 1.95 + .025 i1)), k2 = eIO(seg(ph, 2.72 + .025 i2, 3.02 + .025 i2)), pos = lerp(lerp(r0, r1, k1), r2, k2); leaving at S1: a = 1 - f1, s = 1 - .22 f1; at S2: a = 1 - f2, s = 1 - .2 f2; reset: pos -> r0 by kr, a / s -> 1 by ka (leavers) or kr; z 1 for leavers while kr < .5 (:146-155). FINDING: the plan's "leavers shrink 12 %, survivors glide 0.4-0.5 s" is SPEC prose; the page = 22 % / 20 % over .17 / .2 s, survivors .35 / .30 s + .025 s stagger

timeline.tap: ripple at ph 3.2 (grid cell 0 at (x + .55 w, y + .45 h)) and 4.3 (the +1 plate centre): u = ph - t0 < .5: opacity 1 - u / .5, scale .4 + 2.2 u, centred (fx/tapr) (:157-158)
timeline.lock: lockState (deck.js:221-225): h = eOut(seg(ph, 3.45, 3.66)), b = eIO(seg(ph, 3.6, 3.95)); ph >= 5.8: b = min(b, 1 - es(seg(ph, 5.8, 6.42))) with es(x) = .5 - .5 cos(pi x), h = min(h, 1 - eIO(seg(ph, 6.36, 6.56))); ph < 3.2 or > 9.6: 0. The sheet: hw = (w / 2 + 2) h, bh = lerp(70, h_sheet + 2, b), clip inset(0 (w / 2 - hw) max(0, h_sheet - bh) (w / 2 - hw) round 14 14 0 0), opacity h > .001; art + text opacity 1 - eIO(seg(ph, 5.68, 6.0)) for 5.6 <= ph < 9.6 (:161-163). The clasp + pieces: drawLock (:226-247): pieces rise from the box mouth (lead piece 1 first at 3.25-3.45, the rest 3.4 + .035 j .. 3.8 + .035 j on a quadratic arc 120 k1 above), hold whole as the clasp (rays .3, shadow .5, eye .6 + .1 sin 2t), burst at 6.56 (sep eIO .2 s), fly home 6.66 + .03 i .. 6.98 + .03 i (eIn), lock flash at the box mouth (v .44-.56); the seam of light along the moving edge (gradient 3 px, .6 sin(pi b)); every call per frame in the trace

timeline.flight: fk = seg(ph, 4.35, 5.0), e = eIO(fk): x = lerp(bx, sx, e), y = lerp(by, sy, e) - 260 sin(pi e), w = lerp(bw, sw, e), h = w 614 / 421, rotate(-8 sin(pi e) deg); (bx, by, bw) = the inspect art box, (sx, sy, sw) = altar slot 40; the glow = chrome fx/fly_glow (constant: the inline eased glow loses to anime_v6.css .fly img !important) (:167-168)

cracks.note: the nets ship in P2 (Data/cracks_deck_<lay>.json, already installed; re-serialized from this page session: identical). keepDom = the page's own build-time DOM keep-outs (CRK.domKeep(ui, 8, true, [inspect, fly, tap, burst]) at build(), anime_v61_cracks.js:735), each labelled with its element by walk order; now = the same element's keep-out after the webfonts settled (build() measured some lines with fallback metrics) and with the collection cards at their dealt places (at build they sat untransformed at the grid origin). R8: Unity re-checks its own rects against keepDom; a crack over real text = re-export with the Unity rects

decisions: Ground truth = the live v6.3 deck page: the 6 approved deck stills (v63_deck_01..05, v63_portrait_04) re-render bit-exact through the exporter (check/E7_p4.json), so every part, rect and timeline is read from those pages
